lines.text: Let's make it save us first.
A laboratory for the problems nobody has solved.
Every problem stated properly. Quantified consequences. Real constraints. Criteria you could actually measure.
And every claim carries its kind. A measured fact and an admitted gap never look alike.
Eleven narrow agents research the work, and attack it. None of them decides what is true.
Each day it reads the World Health Organization, the Lancet, Europe PMC. Of a hundred and ninety three documents, thirteen reach a human.
Twenty one open problems. A hundred and forty one real sources. Zero invented citations.
Bring a problem. Bring a source. Bring the objection nobody wants to hear.
